title: The Echoes of Multilinguality: Tracing Cultural Value Shifts during LM Fine-tuning
benchmark_measurement: The study measured how fine-tuning on religious texts (Bible and Quran) and other data sources influences and shifts the cultural values, including religious values as defined by the World Values Survey, encoded within multilingual language models.
findings: Fine-tuning on religious corpora (Parallel Bible Corpus and Tanzil for Quran texts) has a slightly larger impact on shifting the model's encoded cultural values compared to neutral or political texts. The study also found that the different religious biases from the Bible and the Quran have demonstrably different effects on the value shifts, particularly in the 'Religious Values' category of the WVS benchmark.
